title: Evaluated-state provenance record for a tracking submission
description: Minimum machine-readable record that identifies the exact artifact a reported tracking score was computed on, the transformation that produced it, and the evaluator configuration that scored it. The reference-side block is optional by design: it requires ground truth and is not deployable at submission time.

pre_transition_state.description: The tracker output before any post-inference transformation. Omit the artifact only if no transformation was applied, in which case transition.structural_type must be 'none'.

row_identity_fields.description: The tuple that makes a row unique. Required for any state comparison to be well defined.

execution_commit_is_the_declared_commit.description: False where the declared commit is not the commit that was executed. If false, declare execution_commit.

transition.description: The post-inference transformation. 'structural_type' is load-bearing: it determines which downstream diagnostics are even definable.

structural_type.description: row-additive: keys grow, surviving content unchanged. key-additive-content-rewriting: keys grow, surviving content changed. rewrite-only: keys unchanged, content changed. identity-remapping: surviving identities change and rows may be lost.

stages.description: In applied order. Order is part of the record because stage composition is not commutative.

call_site.description: Where the parameter values actually came from: a __main__ block, an argparse default, a signature default, or a documented command.

parameters.description: Name to value. Record the values used, not the defaults, and record the semantics where a name is ambiguous.

parameter_semantics.description: One line per parameter stating the exact condition it controls, including strictness of inequalities.

inserted_row_marking.description: How an inserted row is distinguishable in the output, if at all. 'none' is the common and problematic case.

evaluated_state.description: The exact artifact that was scored. This is the field whose absence motivates the whole record.

evaluation.description: What produced the reported number. An evaluator commit alone is insufficient: configuration defaults change scoring semantics.

definition.description: The construction rule, explicitly. A split name is not a definition.

configuration.description: Every setting that changes scoring semantics, INCLUDING values left at their defaults. Record the resolved value, not the command line.

reference_side_diagnostics.description: OPTIONAL. Requires ground truth for the evaluated split and is therefore not computable by a submitter at submission time, and not deployable. A record without this block is still complete.

class_counts.description: Admission classes of the inserted rows. Defined only when transition.structural_type is 'row-additive'.

withheld_row_state.description: The R1 state: the evaluated state with non-admitted inserted rows withheld. A row subset of the evaluated state; requires no evaluator change to score.

selection_provenance.description: Whether the checkpoint was chosen without consulting the evaluated split. 'No recorded validation metric' is NOT 'confirmed'; it is 'unresolved'.
